package h

import "testing"

func newThing() int { return 1 + 0 }

func wrapped() int { return newThing() }

func TestOne(t *testing.T) {
	if newThing() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("one")
	}
}

func TestTwo(t *testing.T) { _ = newThing() }

func TestThree(t *testing.T) {}

func TestFour(t *testing.T) { _ = wrapped() }
